title: Eastern CT Fly Fishing

services.name: Eastern CT Fall Fishing
services.desc: Fall is a favorite time of mine to fish river and streams in Eastern Connecticut. DEEP has concluded its fall stocking so many popular fishing spots have been refreshed. The TMA’s received their fall stock as well. Temperatures are back in trout friendly ranges and fishing pressure is generally lower. Although we are past peak and much of the foliage is down, there still is some beautiful colors out there. My Galvan Torque adds to it. As you can see, this is a holdover rainbow with its darker colors. More fall colors in this photo. This bow is a stocker from this fall with its silvery colors.
